leadText:
Sheridan (Japanese: セキドー Sekidō) is a character of the day who appeared in Cheer Pressure.

Sheridan was the leader of a Pokémon cheering squad. He claimed that cheering during a Pokémon battle would help a Pokémon heal itself, and allow it to gain the upper hand. Thatcher thought this was an interesting concept, so he joined the cheering squad.

However, when and visited the school, they immediately became suspicious. Max even thought he saw electricity flowing from the drums. After spying on Sheridan, he discovered that the entire concept was a fraud to make him rich. Pokémon were being hidden in the drums and using and during battles.

 heard about Sheridan's cheerleading school and thought they could use his cheering powers to finally beat Ash and steal . However, this plan was ruined when Max pushed the drums the Pokémon were hidden in, exposing Sheridan's scheme. 

After his fraudulent activities were uncovered, Sheridan took off running, promising to send a check. It is not known what happened to him after the incident.
